segments.text:
V. 45.
The kingdom of heaven—That is, one who earneſtly feeles for it: In the 47th Verſe it means, The Goſpel preached, which is like a net gathering of every Kind: Juſt ſo the Goſpel wherever it is preached, gathers at firſt both good and bad, who are for a Seaſon full of Approbation and warm with good Deſires. But Chriſtian Diſcipline, and ſtrong, cloſe Exhortation, begin that Separation in this World, which ſhall be accompliſhed by the Angels of GOD, in the World to come.
